title: Gaze-Aware AI: Mathematical modeling of epistemic experience of the Marginalized for Human-Computer Interaction & AI Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a Gaze Pressure Index (GPI)-Diff Composite Metric to quantify the epistemic and affective divergence between different social groups (specifically an LGBTQ+ community and a conservative political community) based on linguistic coping behaviors in online texts.
models_tested: The paper proposes a method for training Large Language Models (LLMs) and mentions 'AI products such as Chat-GPT' as a potential application. The methodology uses 'Hugging Face zero-shot classification' but does not name or evaluate any specific LLMs.
findings: The paper does not analyze religion or faith; therefore, it presents no findings related to these topics. The key findings relate to the measurable 'epistemic and affective divergence' between an LGBTQ+ subreddit and a conservative subreddit, demonstrating a significant difference in coping styles and emotional burden.
